occurrenceChecks.text: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 固定WEB本文が対象個人名または部族・氏族名を明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: この節のShechemは逃れの町の都市名であり、JOS17:2の「シェケムの子ら」という氏族名と同名の別対象。

occurrenceChecks.text: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: この節のShechemはレビ人に与えられた町で、氏族シェケムではない。

occurrenceChecks.text: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: この節のShechemはヤコブが土地を買った町で、氏族シェケムではない。
